surface.host: apps/web/src/main.tsx renders the view on the /data workbench route for every signed-in actor
surface.transport: same-origin read-only fetch with cache no-store and the existing x-csrf-token header
surface.singleAuthority: No new execution endpoint was added; certified results still originate only from the audited gateway capability company.data.query

behavior.readModelScope: The read model projects only the actor's own audited results. The query is limited by tenant and owner RLS to tool_actions rows with capability_id 'company.data.query' and state VERIFIED or FAILED, is additionally constrained by an explicit tenant predicate, optionally filtered by task_id, and the sealed payload is unsealed in process by RuntimeStore.openToolResult.
behavior.auditCrossCheck: Every unsealed result is compared item by item against its data_executions audit row within the same tenant (template key and version, status, completeness, watermark, observed_at, row_count). Any mismatch drops the record, so contradictory or unattributable data never reaches the view.
behavior.strictListParsing: Each result must carry a UUID, well-formed template key and version, a 64-hex template hash, canonical UTC timestamps, a watermark no later than the observation, an ordered time window, a row count equal to the metric attempts, a row scope of one to sixteen valid key-value pairs and an upstreamCertification of UNVERIFIED. The list must declare platformCertification LOCAL_GOLDEN_ONLY, liveVerified false, a boolean truncated flag and at most 50 unique rows; the catalog holds at most 64 rows.
behavior.catalogGatedLoading: If the catalog cannot be read, every result is cleared as well, because the freshness limit registered per metric is required to decide whether an overall conclusion is permitted.
behavior.conclusionRules: A truncated or sampled result, an execution status other than OK, or a watermark lagging more than the registered freshness limit (1440 minutes by default) always refuses an overall conclusion; the view still shows the metric definition, time window, row scope and freshness lag. Otherwise the conclusion is stated inside the authorized row scope and that time window only.
behavior.pendingDefinition: A business question is answered from the certified catalog only when it names a certified metric or template identifier. With no certified template covering it, the view produces the pending definition elements (scope and metric boundary, numerator and denominator, deduplication and validity rules, time grain and time zone, freshness ceiling, classification and allowed roles, certification evidence and golden cases) and states no number.
behavior.failureHandling: 4xx, 5xx and network failures produce Chinese notices only, never server text, never a retained old result; 401 clears all data and invokes the existing session-lost callback.
behavior.lifecycle: A visibility change or unmount clears the loaded results and any late reply, and the notice asks for an explicit reload.
behavior.noUpstreamAccess: The view never reads or writes upstream data, carries no SQL, row scope rule, credential or upstream tool name, and never claims platform certification or live verification.
